description: Three-panel set of isothermal phase sections of Fe–Mn–C–Al low-density steel at 900 °C: (a) Mn 10%, (b) Mn 20%, (c) Mn 30%. Every panel plots C (wt%) on the ordinate (0–4) against Al (wt%) on the abscissa (0–14); no numeric values are printed inside the fields. Fields are colour coded as stated in the caption — light gray = austenite (γ), gold = ferrite (α), blue = κ phase — and are labelled in the panels: γ, γ+α, γ+M3C, γ+M3C+κ, γ+κ, γ+κ+α, α+κ and B2+κ, with a narrow κ strip appearing at the top right of (b) and (c) and a small α field at the bottom right of (b) and (c). Boundaries are drawn as thin gray lines, black dashed lines and bold red solid curves; in (b) and (c) the red solid curves are overlaid on the dashed set, plausibly experimental boundaries on CALPHAD ones. Discrete symbols — open circles, open squares, open triangles, filled circles, filled squares, filled diamonds — mark measured alloy compositions, but their legend is not printed in the image. Across (a)→(c) the γ field extends toward higher Al, ferrite-bearing γ+α, α+κ and B2+κ fields widen at high Al, and the γ+M3C region retreats.

observations.observation: The figure comprises three isothermal phase sections of Fe–Mn–C–Al alloys at 900 °C, for Mn 10% (a), Mn 20% (b) and Mn 30% (c).
In every panel the abscissa is Al (wt%) spanning 0–14 and the ordinate is C (wt%) spanning 0–4, with ticks every 2 and every 0.5 respectively.
The caption states the colour coding: light gray = austenite, gold = ferrite, blue = κ phase.
Phase fields labelled in the panels are γ, γ+α, γ+M3C, γ+M3C+κ, γ+κ, γ+κ+α, α+κ, B2+κ, plus κ and α fields that appear only in panels (b) and (c).
Boundaries are drawn with two line styles in all panels — thin gray/black dashed lines and bold red solid curves — with the red solid curves overlaid on the dashed set in (b) and (c).
The citing text states the isothermal sections were constructed 'based on experiments and CALPHAD' and that the meaning of points and lines in Figure 2 is taken from ref. [41].

Discrete experimental-composition symbols appear as open circles, open squares, open triangles, filled circles, filled squares and filled diamonds; no legend or numeric composition table is printed in the image.
In panel (a) open circles lie inside the γ field at roughly Al 4–9 and C 0.7–1.5, and filled squares sit on the abscissa near C≈0.1–0.2 at Al≈8.5–9.5.
The citing text reports that with increasing Mn content the austenite (γ) region expands in the high-Al area (>8 wt%) and the κ phase region expands at high C (>3 wt%) and high Al (>10 wt%).
The citing text reports that when C exceeds 1.2 wt%, M3C and κ phases emerge in the low-density steel.
The citing text reports that increasing Al expands the ferrite (α) phase region at high Al in the 20–30 wt% Mn containing Fe–Mn–C–Al steels.

Comparing the panels visually, the γ field extends to progressively higher Al and the ferrite-bearing γ+α, α+κ and B2+κ fields widen on the right side as Mn increases from 10% to 30%, while the white γ+M3C region shrinks.
No numeric composition, temperature or solubility value is printed inside any of the three panels; only axis ticks are numeric.

subfigures.description: Isothermal section for Mn 10% at 900 °C (C wt% 0–4 vs Al wt% 0–14). Large light-gray γ field lower-left; white γ+M3C upper-left; blue γ+M3C+κ at top centre; γ+κ at centre-right; narrow γ+κ+α wedge; gold α+κ band at far right and a thin B2+κ strip at Al 13–14. Open circles lie in the γ field, open triangles in γ+κ, filled squares near C≈0.1–0.2 at Al≈8.5–9.5.

Isothermal section for Mn 20% at 900 °C. Red solid experimental boundaries overlaid on the black dashed/gray calculated boundaries. New fields versus (a): a blue κ field and a white α region at top right, a γ+α field and small α field at bottom right, expanded gold α+κ and B2+κ bands. Symbols: open squares, open circles, open triangles, filled squares and filled circles at low C, plus filled diamonds inside α+κ and B2+κ.

Isothermal section for Mn 30% at 900 °C. Red solid boundaries again overlaid on dashed/gray lines. Fields labelled γ, γ+M3C, γ+M3C+κ, γ+κ, κ, γ+κ+α, γ+α, α (small, bottom right), α+κ (gold) and B2+κ; the γ+α field reaches lower C and higher Al than in (a). Symbols include an open square at high C, open circles, open triangles, a filled triangle near α+κ at Al≈11.5, a filled diamond in α+κ and a filled circle in B2+κ near Al≈13.8.

unreadable_items: No legend is printed for the point symbols (open circles/squares/triangles, filled circles/squares/diamonds), so which experimental condition each symbol marks cannot be read from the image
The distinction between the thin gray lines and the black dashed lines is not reliably resolvable at the supplied resolution in panels (b) and (c)
Individual data-point compositions are not labelled numerically in any panel
